objects.description: [TeamPCP Cloud Stealer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9041) has checked if it is running on a developer machine (rather than GitHub Actions) before executing a Python script for persistence. The script has also polled C2 every 50 minutes for additional payloads and aborted if the returned value contained YouTube.(Citation: Aqua Security Blog Trivy Compromise APR 2026)(Citation: Wiz TeamPCP KICS MAR 2026)
